# Bread flour — technical datasheet (new supplier)

> Fictional supplier document, written for this example. Received with the
> 2026-09-04 delivery.

- Protein: 11.5 % (± 0.5).
- Falling number: 250-300 s.
- Ash: 0.55 %.
- Recommended hydration: 60-65 % for tin bread, up to 70 % for hearth
  loaves.
- Storage: dry, below 25 °C; best before 6 months from milling.
- Milled from a blend of winter wheats; the blend can vary between
  harvests.
